# dsh-plugin-pomodoro
A **Pomodoro timer plus a Trello-style task board** for **DeepSeek Harness** — the timer floats over
the app, the board lives in the same overlay, and the focus time you spend is credited to the task

lives in the same overlay, and the focus time you spend is credited to the task
you are working on.

The plugin has two halves: a browser-only client (the floating timer and the board UI) and a small
h

ost half that stores the board in **SQLite** under your DSH home and exposes it through five
authent

icated routes. Nothing here reaches the model: no tools, prompts, session events, or provider
reques

ted routes. Nothing here reaches the model: no tools, prompts, session events, or provider
requests.
## Features

### Focus timer
- Floating pill in the shell overlay with the countdown, phase and pulse; expands in

to a card with
ring progress, cycle dots, start/pause/skip/reset and settings.
- Focus / short break

/ long break cycle (25/5/15 by default, long break every 4 focus blocks).
- Keyboard: `Space` start

/pause, `S` skip, `R` reset, `Esc` collapse, `B` open/close the board.
- Optional chime, desktop not

ifications and inline completion banner.
- The clock stores an absolute deadline, so reloads, thrott
led tabs and sleep do not drift it.

### Task board (Trello-style)
- **Custom lists** (To Do / Doing / Done by default): create, rename i

nline, reorder by dragging,
mark a list as the completion list, delete with task reassignment.
- **C

ards** with priority (none/low/medium/high), colored labels, due date, estimate, notes,
subtasks, tr

acked time and pomodoro count.
- **Full composer** (all fields plus subtask rows before creating) an

d a **task drawer** for
everything afterwards, including subtask checklists and label assignment.
-

**Drag & drop** cards between columns with an insertion line; drag list handles to reorder
columns.

Accessible alternatives: the card's “Move to list” menu and `Alt+←/→/↑/↓` on a focused
card.
- **Sma

rt sections** in the rail with live counts: All tasks, Today, Overdue, Tomorrow, This week,
Next 7 d

ays, High/Medium/Low priority, No due date, Completed.
- **Four per-section metrics**: Estimated tim

e, To complete, Elapsed time, Completed — with an
estimate-scope toggle (all tasks / open tasks only

ters**, and manual / due / priority / creation ordering.
- **JSON export and import** of the whole b
oard with a validated confirmation step.

### Focus minutes that add up
- **Focus** on a card or in the drawer links the task to the timer.
-

The plugin measures **real focus time** (pause, reset, skip, switching tasks and phase completion
al

l settle the segment) and credits it to the task; a completed focus phase adds one pomodoro.
- Credi

ts are **idempotent** (`creditId`) and queue locally when the host is unreachable, so a
reload or a

retried request never double-counts.
- Phases that finished while the app was closed are replayed on

never double-counts.
- Phases that finished while the app was closed are replayed on the next load.
| Today section with metrics | Task drawer | Composer |
| Task focused by the timer | Board menu | Import confirmation |
| Inline label panel in the drawer | Label manager |
The timer widget and its Plugins configuration page are unchanged:
| Collapsed | Expanded | Plugins → Configure |
## Enable, disable, configure — in the Plugins page
**Plugins** (sidebar) → *Installed plugins* → `dsh-plugin-pomodoro`:

- **Profile level** — the bundle switch and the **Component** switch (writes
`- id: pomodoro / disab

led: true` into the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`, unloading the plugin live
on a profile with HMR).
- **Plugin level** — **Configure** hides/shows the timer widget and edits its defaults. Board data i

s
not affected by those switches.

dsh.profile.bundles` entry. Restart DeepSeek Harness once to load the plugin in the desktop window.

See docs/install.md for the full recipe, rollback, version-specific details and
the log locations.
## Storage
- **Board data → SQLite** at `$DSH_HOME/pomodoro/board.sqlite` (WAL; `config.dbPath` overrides it).

A daily rotating backup is written to `board.sqlite.bak` (plus `.bak.1` … `.bak.7`).
- **Per-window

presentation** (active section, search, label filter, ordering) → `localStorage`.
- **Timer record a

nd widget preferences** → `localStorage` (`dsh-plugin-pomodoro:state:v1`,
`:prefs:v1`, `:ui:v1`); pe
nding focus credits are queued in `:pending-credits:v1`.
See docs/board.md for the data model, HTTP routes and limits.

## Design notes

- **Host owns the data.** Board state is human knowledge, not conversation state: SQLite, WAL,
trans

actional commands and idempotent time credits keep it durable and consistent, while the
browser stay

s a thin, replaceable view.
- **One authenticated surface.** Five exact routes ride DSH's connection

carrier: HTTP + cookie in
the web app, and the desktop shell's `dsh-app://` proxy (same cookie) in

Electron.
- **Hand-written bundle.** `lib/client.js` is committed and served straight from the packa

and-written bundle.** `lib/client.js` is committed and served straight from the package, so
[该节后续省略]
## Known limitations

- One board per DSH home; no sharing or multi-device sync. Use JSON export/import to move boards.
-
Data lives on the host that owns the profile: two different DSH installations do not share a board.

- Drag & drop uses the pointer; keyboard/menu alternatives are the accessible path.
- Tested on macO
S with DSH 0.2.1-rc.2; Windows/Linux are unverified.
